I farm here in the North East, and this maize plot is small — only 0.57 hectares — and it is rented, so I cannot spend too much on it. I will try to get some NPK and urea from the agro-dealer if the subsidy reaches us, because maize without fertilizer gives almost nothing on our tired soil. I will use the improved seed I bought last year if I can find it again, but I have no money for pesticide or irrigation — I depend on the rains from June. My children and I will do most of the weeding ourselves, and I will hire a few people only for land preparation and harvest.
